But the problem with your country has to do with the question if it is wise to tie down ones country to other countries, and if so, in what way that should happen. Let me first start by stating that there are two extremes in cooperation between nations, first there is the autarkic countries that have no need for cooperation and trade, or they do not wish it, the other hand is a cooperation in which countries have given up their own autonomy in exchange for full fledged union with other countries, essentially ceasing to exist. I would argue that a country needs to find a middle ground between the two. If a country were to cooperate with other countries it is best that it does so on terms agreeable to the interests of that nation, it is easier to make deals with countries that have largely the same social, economic, cultural and political movements and interests as ones own. Greater cooperation with countries more or less the same is wise, with countries in a different structure one should be wary.

Your country however is on the forefront of a power clash between the EU (we are not free from blame here) and Russia, in our opinion, your politics are beyond our comprehension, you have recently had undemocratic presidents ousting democratically elected ones, regularily there are factories that are seized in Ukraine and your corruption is higher than we would wish.
